# note: Shaper + Elder influenced rare with two influence-only prefixes, a bench craft, blank lines between mods (3.26-era client). Posted in patch 3.26; its "Entombing" prefix shows Adds (41-54) to (81-93) Cold Damage to Spells, while the 3.29 data (RePoE 04/09/2026 and Path of Building 23/08/2026 agree) has (52-69) to (103-118) for the wand mod SpellAddedColdDamage9 and no mod with the old ranges, so the parser refuses it: an item from an older patch that no longer matches the data (STATUS.md milestone 3, patch drift). The Shaper + Elder case that parses is rare-amulet-shaper-elder-mirrored-quantity.
